parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Answer table: $x$: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6. $P(X=x)$: $6/36,12/36,6/36,6/36,6/36$, equivalently $1/6,1/3,1/6,1/6,1/6$, or decimals 0.167, 0.333, 0.167, 0.167, 0.167. Marks: B1 for correct x values and at least one correct probability linked to the correct x-value. Guidance: values need not be ordered; lines need not be drawn; table may be vertical; x and P(X) may be omitted; condone additional x-values with probability 0. Marks: B1 for four correct probabilities linked to correct x-values; need not be in a table; accept unsimplified. Marks: B1 for all five correct probabilities linked to correct x-values; may be outside a table; decimals correct to at least 3 significant figures. Guidance: SC B1 for four or five probabilities summing to 1 in a probability distribution table with four or five x-values between 1 and 6 inclusive. Total: 3.
